digest.component_or_area: plan-review-T15 eval specification and test coverage
propositions: Add a packaged T15 eval specification with deterministic scorers covering applicable/pass deployed-service plans that name boot, auth, authorization, connectivity, and readiness risks with concrete out-of-loop proof and scoped cleanup.

Add eval fixture cases for applicable/finding destructive-cleanup scenarios involving pre-existing table drops and shared bucket wipes where only slow delivery loop feedback or cleanup side effects occur.
Add not-applicable/pass fixture cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and incidental deploy plans plus S2/S3 boundary cases.
Extend test_new_eval_specs.py and test_t15_overlay_derisk_criterion.py to validate spec schema, scorer discipline, balanced datasets, case identifiers, applicability matrix, and gold set coverage.
Record T15 application-scope false positives and regression guards in the observed-false-positives.md ledger.
